abstract: The bronchial tree exhibits a striking fractal architecture that enables efficient ventilation, but how this geometry emerges during development has remained unclear. Mederacke et al. show that local mechanical and hydrodynamic feedback progressively drives the self-organization of fractal airway geometry across development, regeneration, and disease.
